## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Full-Stack Web & Software Engineering
- Modern web architectures powered by Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- Headless ecommerce, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, and microservice cloud backends.
- High-performance database modeling with PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM.
- Containerization and CI/CD automation with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.
- URL: https://eliweb.in/services#software

### 2. Commercial Video Production & Cinematic Brand Storytelling
- Commercial brand films, high-retention social reels, and product launch trailers.
- End-to-end production: Concept scripting, 4K/6K cinematography, color grading, sound design, and master delivery.
- URL: https://eliweb.in/services#creative

### 3. Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy
- Data-driven performance marketing: Google Ads, Meta Ads, and automated retargeting funnels.
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and local search authority.
- Social media content pipelines and reputation architecture.
- URL: https://eliweb.in/services#marketing

### 4. UI/UX & Design Systems
- Enterprise design systems and design tokens in Figma.
- User research, wireframing, and interactive prototyping.
- Luxury editorial and modern SaaS visual resonance.
- URL: https://eliweb.in/services#design

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How long does a website take to build?
High-velocity marketing and brand websites typically launch within 2 to 4 weeks. Complex full-stack platforms, headless architectures, and custom web applications generally range from 6 to 12 weeks with staged weekly milestone reviews.

### What technology stack does EliWeb use?
Our primary engineering stack is built on Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, and modern cloud platforms (Vercel, AWS, Neon).

### How does EliWeb ensure performance and SEO?
Every platform is engineered with server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), structured JSON-LD schema (Organization, Service, FAQPage), edge caching, and optimized media pipelines to achieve 90+ Google PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals scores.

### How do we get started with EliWeb?
Clients can request a Discovery Session or Technical Review directly at https://eliweb.in/contact or via WhatsApp at +91 79 7385 1691. Our architects respond with initial technical scope within 24 hours.
